items.q: Well-defined milky-white non-scaly patches that glow bright under Wood lamp with premature hair greying are?
items.exp: Vitiligo is autoimmune melanocyte loss with depigmented Wood-accentuated patches, often with thyroid disease.
r: Correct. Milky non-scaly glowing patches.
Incorrect. That scales with yellow glow.
Incorrect. That is faint and ill-defined.
Incorrect. Those are tiny confetti shin spots.

items.q: Segmental depigmentation confined to one facial dermatome that stabilises early is?
items.exp: Segmental vitiligo starts young, spreads within a segment then stabilises, with early poliosis.
r: Incorrect. That is symmetric and progressive.
Incorrect. That is stable from birth without glow.
Incorrect. That flags tuberous sclerosis.
Correct. Dermatomal early-stable course.
items.kp: Dermatomal stable depigmentation is segmental vitiligo.

items.q: Symmetric brown facial patches worsening with sun and pregnancy that enhance under Wood lamp are?
items.exp: Melasma is acquired symmetric facial hyperpigmentation; Wood enhancement marks epidermal pigment.
r: Incorrect. That is contact-pigmented with itch.
Incorrect. That diffuses with systemic features.
Correct. Symmetric sun-hormone facial brown.
Incorrect. Those are small discrete sun spots.

items.q: Baseline care for melasma in all patients includes?
items.exp: Ultraviolet drives melasma so daily broad-spectrum protection underpins every depigmenting plan.
r: Incorrect. Scrubbing worsens pigmentation.
Correct. Sunscreen is the base of melasma care.
Incorrect. Mercury is toxic and banned.
Incorrect. Sun advice is central.

items.q: Perifollicular repigmentation dots inside a vitiligo patch during therapy signal?
o: Active melanocyte recovery and good prognosis
items.exp: Follicular reservoirs reseed pigment as dots that coalesce, the earliest sign of responding vitiligo.
r: Correct. Dotted refill means recovery.
Incorrect. Dots mark response, not failure.
Incorrect. No atypia is implied.
Incorrect. Spread would whiten further.
items.kp: Follicular dots mean vitiligo is repigmenting.

items.q: Confetti-like porcelain-white macules on shins in an elderly diabetic are?
items.exp: Guttate hypomelanosis gives tiny discrete hypopigmented shin macules of sun ageing, stable and benign.
r: Incorrect. That gives large milky patches.
Incorrect. That gives ivory atrophic plaques.
Incorrect. That gives bound-down sclerosis.
Correct. Tiny confetti shin spots.
items.kp: Confetti shin spots are guttate hypomelanosis.

items.q: Generalised bronze pigmentation with palmar crease darkening, weakness and hypotension suggests?
items.exp: Adrenal failure raises ACTH with diffuse pigmentation plus salt-wasting collapse needing steroid replacement.
r: Incorrect. That stays facial and symmetric.
Incorrect. That whitens, not darkens.
Correct. Diffuse tan with collapse.
Incorrect. That bronzes with diabetes and arthropathy.
items.kp: Diffuse bronze with collapse is Addison.

items.q: A child with silvery-grey hair, nystagmus and bleeding tendency has?
o: Chediak-Higashi or Griscelli pigment-immune syndromes needing referral
items.exp: Silvery hair with immune or neurologic features marks lysosomal-trafficking syndromes needing urgent workup.
r: Incorrect. That pales without hair change.
Correct. Silvery hair plus systemic flags.
Incorrect. That lacks hair and eye signs.
Incorrect. Albinism lacks immune defects.
items.kp: Silvery hair with bleeds needs syndrome workup.

items.q: Post-inflammatory marks after healed eczema darken most in which patients and with what course?
o: Darker skin types with gradual fading over months
items.exp: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation follows dermatitis, deeper in pigmented skin, fading slowly with sun protection.
r: Correct. Darker skin fades slowly.
Incorrect. Fair skin marks fade faster.
Incorrect. Clearing takes months.
Incorrect. Albinos cannot hyperpigment much.

items.q: Ochronotic banana-shaped fibres on biopsy with grey-blue ear cartilage and dark urine suggest?
items.exp: Alkaptonuria deposits homogentisic polymer in cartilage and skin with dark urine and arthritis.
r: Incorrect. That greys from silver exposure.
Incorrect. That photosensitises slate-grey.
Incorrect. That blues scars and shins.
Correct. Blue ears with dark urine.
items.kp: Blue ears with dark urine is alkaptonuria.
